dct_title_s: Somalia Subnational Population Data Tables with Administrative Boundaries, Based on Surveys
dct_description_sm: The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first- and second-order administrative divisions, aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided. The tabular data contain total population for 2005 (population estimates) and 2014 (population estimates), as well as information relating to education, health, malaria, conflict, insecurity, stresses, and needs.
